narration.full_text: In this section, we'll embark on an exciting journey into the world of real numbers and factorization. You'll learn to define and classify different types of real numbers, understanding their unique properties. We'll explore the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, a cornerstone of number theory, and see how it applies to prime factorization. You'll master the techniques for performing prime factorization and then use it to efficiently calculate the Highest Common Factor and Least Common Multiple of numbers. Finally, we'll delve into proving the irrationality of certain numbers and apply our knowledge to solve practical word problems involving HCF and LCM. Get ready to build a strong foundation in number systems!
